query: WITH valid_scope AS ( SELECT team.id AS team_id, account.id AS user_id FROM teams team JOIN users account ON account.id = $2 WHERE team.id = $1 AND team.active AND account.active ), updated AS ( UPDATE team_memberships membership SET role = $3::text::scoped_membership_role, etag = $4, updated_at = now() FROM valid_scope WHERE membership.team_id = valid_scope.team_id AND membership.user_id = valid_scope.user_id AND $6::uuid IS NOT NULL AND membership.etag = $6 RETURNING membership.team_id, membership.user_id, membership.role, membership.etag, membership.created_by, membership.created_at, membership.updated_at ), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO team_memberships (team_id, user_id, role, etag, created_by, created_at, updated_at) SELECT team_id, user_id, $3::text::scoped_membership_role, $4, $5, now(), now() FROM valid_scope WHERE $6::uuid IS NULL ON CONFLICT (team_id, user_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING team_id, user_id, role, etag, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT team_id AS "team_id!", user_id AS "user_id!", role::text AS "role!", etag AS "etag!", created_by AS "created_by!", created_at AS "created_at!", updated_at AS "updated_at!" FROM updated UNION ALL SELECT team_id, user_id, role::text AS "role!", etag, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM inserted
